IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(BLs)};BM=np.array(BLm,float);NEG=-1e9
def enc(s): return np.array([IDX.get(c,-1) for c in s])
def blm(s1,s2):
    a=enc(s1);b=enc(s2);M=np.full((len(a),len(b)),-4.0);va=a>=0;vb=b>=0
    M[np.ix_(va,vb)]=BM[np.ix_(a[va],b[vb])];return M
def nw_vec(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2);SC=blm(s1,s2)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);X=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Y=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);M[0,0]=0.
    X[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);Y[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);j=np.arange(m+1,dtype=float)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        M[i,1:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:-1],X[i-1,:-1]),Y[i-1,:-1])+SC[i-1,:]
        X[i,1:]=np.maximum(M[i-1,1:]+go,X[i-1,1:]+ge);X[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1)
        V=np.maximum(M[i,:],X[i,:])+go-ge*j;acc=np.maximum.accumulate(V)
        Y[i,:]=ge*j+np.concatenate(([NEG],acc[:-1]));Y[i,0]=NEG
    i,jj=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],X[n,m],Y[n,m]]));pr=[]
    while i>0 or jj>0:
        if st==0: pr.append((i-1,jj-1));st=int(np.argmax([M[i-1,jj-1],X[i-1,jj-1],Y[i-1,jj-1]]));i-=1;jj-=1
        elif st==1: st=0 if abs(X[i,jj]-(M[i-1,jj]+go))<1e-6 else 1;i-=1
        else:
            st=0 if abs(Y[i,jj]-(M[i,jj-1]+go))<1e-6 else (1 if abs(Y[i,jj]-(X[i,jj-1]+go))<1e-6 else 2);jj-=1
        if i<=0 and jj<=0: break
        if i<0 or jj<0: break
    return pr[::-1]
